provenance.purpose: Per-tick trajectory digest for seed 1 at 200 agents under RangedStandoffV8, captured from the src/ tree at commit 19870ff, unmodified by RU-27 (a tests-only task). This freezes the ranged-standoff preset's trajectory at RU-27's own commit: any later change that moves it -- a projectile-flight edit, a standoff-distance edit, a pipeline reorder -- reproduces this fixture byte-identically or ships a new preset version with new golden expectations.
provenance.eventFoldSpecification: Per tick, start at the canonical FNV-1a 64-bit offset basis 14695981039346656037 and fold, for each event of that tick in emission order, the twelve words HeadlessRunner.AddEventToHash folds: (ulong)Sequence, (ulong)Tick, (ulong)Kind, SourceEntityId, TargetEntityId ?? 0, (ulong)(uint)Value, FactionId is int f ? (ulong)(uint)f : ulong.MaxValue, Weapon is WeaponId w ? (ulong)(uint)(int)w : ulong.MaxValue, Shield is ShieldId s ? (ulong)(uint)(int)s : ulong.MaxValue, HitLocation is BodyPart h ? (ulong)(uint)(int)h : ulong.MaxValue, Resolution is AttackResolution r ? (ulong)(uint)(int)r : ulong.MaxValue, ComboPosition is int p ? (ulong)(uint)p : ulong.MaxValue. This is the same fold the headless runner and the benchmark script use to report eventHash, so this fixture's per-tick eventFold column is directly comparable to that output at the same tick.
provenance.stateHashSpecification: The parameterless BattleSimulation.ComputeStateHash() taken immediately after each AdvanceOneTick().
provenance.harnessDisposition: Captured by the committed, HUKBO_CALIBRATION-gated CaptureRangedStandoffV8Digest routine in tests/Hukbo.Core.Tests/MovementPresetFreezeTests.cs, run once via: dotnet test tests/Hukbo.Core.Tests/Hukbo.Core.Tests.csproj -c Release -p:DefineConstants=HUKBO_CALIBRATION --filter FullyQualifiedName~CaptureRangedStandoffV8Digest --logger "console;verbosity=detailed". Unlike V1 through V7, this routine was not deleted after capture.
provenance.schemaNote: The finalAgents rows carry real values for contingentId and contingentState: RangedStandoffV8 populates both AgentState.ContingentId and AgentState.ContingentState, unlike the frozen IndependentPursuitV1 fixture, which reserves both columns as 0.

scenario.construction: Scenario.CreateDefault(1, 200) with MovementPreset = MovementPresetId.RangedStandoffV8, BodyRadiusRaw = 4 * FixedPoint.Scale, and CombatPreset = CombatPresetId.PrecolonialPhilippinesV2, then BattleSimulation.Create(scenario). The body radius and combat preset are pinned explicitly to the same values the V1-V7 fixtures were captured under, not to the shipped defaults, so the eight frozen trajectories stay directly comparable.
